interpretation: The current Vision terms expressly allow algorithmic historical backtesting for purely personal non-production research under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, with attribution/share-alike conditions.

The same terms prohibit live proprietary trading execution, automated commercial order generation, and compensated third-party signal distribution. The user explicitly restricted this project to historical backtesting and excluded Vision-derived live/manual signals; those uses will not be pursued here.

The user explicitly authorized Vision use for historical backtesting only and excluded live/manual signals derived from it. The user separately authorized research into official KRX/CRSP sample and price-quote information only, without accounts or purchases.

The inspected candle DBs do not contain historical funding, premium/index/mark-price, or point-in-time contract-universe tables. The six-symbol repaired data are not sufficient to establish a broad futures-universe, funding-adjusted strategy result.

An official source path is documented but not yet verified: Vision publishes USD-M premium-index, mark-price, and index-price kline archives from 2020-01-01; the official funding-history endpoint supports inclusive timestamp windows, ascending results, and up to 1000 records per request. Actual per-symbol history, full pagination, API retention, and delisted-contract membership remain unverified.

Trend/momentum, cross-sectional/regime, and red-team reviewers recommended no performance test; the mean-reversion reviewer found premium/index basis mechanically distinct from price-only VWAP/RSI but also recommended no-go until coverage is verified. Agents did not inspect the checkout or raw databases.
No strategy metrics, indicator values, or return outcomes were calculated. No sealed interval was accessed.
